prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: pixel-art upper-eye atlas for an existing DFU NPC talking portrait.
Input image: Image 1 is the exact prepared 2x2 current-copy reference grid for NPC073 guarded eyes; use it as the character, palette, proportions, framing, cell geometry, pixel style, and lid-phase reference.
Primary request: Generate one clean 2x2 atlas, same overall 64:35 aspect ratio as the reference. Each cell is the same complete upper-half portrait crop, not a close-up or independent eye crop. Row-major cells: top-left LEFT OPEN, top-right RIGHT OPEN, bottom-left LEFT HALF, bottom-right RIGHT HALF. LEFT and RIGHT mean both pupils move together toward that same screen side by only a tiny natural horizontal glance, about one native pixel; they do not point inward toward each other. Keep the gaze synchronized between both eyes.
Subject and expression: Preserve NPC073's guarded skeptical expression: asymmetric raised brow on one side and lower/flatter brow on the other, with the same brow shape and placement in all four cells. Keep a restrained, appraising look distinct from neutral and angry.
Eye anatomy: Preserve the source's narrow apertures, exact guarded eye scale, compact amber-brown irises and pupil clusters, upper/lower lid contours, original pale glints, and muted skin shading. Shift only the iris/pupil clusters horizontally inside the existing openings. The half row uses the same guarded half-lid closure as the reference while retaining visible compact irises. Do not widen the eyes, expose broad white sclera bands, enlarge pupils, change iris hue, add highlights, tilt the gaze vertically, or alter brows between cells.
Composition and style: Native pixel-art rendering with the reference's muted warm palette, sharp stepped clusters, original hair/blue side ornament and face registration. Preserve the complete crop boundaries of each reference cell and repeat the same face across all cells.
Avoid: labels, text, gutters, borders, dividers, full-face views, extra panels, smooth vector shapes, anti-aliased blur, broad white bands, expression changes, asymmetrical eye direction, eye-size changes, artifacting, watermark.
